prompt_history.exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / industrial design concept.
Redesign the robot enclosure in reference image 1; reference image 2 is the Tangpa robot and is ONLY the benchmark for exceptionally coherent rounded shell integration, side-mounted hips, neatly wrapped legs and clean shoes. Produce a new professionally drawn monochrome industrial-design sheet, not a purported CAD render or engineering certification.

Preserve the identity and overall architecture of Goose in reference 1: long horizontal mango-shaped body with gently raised tapering tail, legs mounted on the BODY SIDES, two short articulated legs, long elegant S-shaped goose neck, the existing goose head with one small square camera faceplate and a single central camera lens, two intact long goose bill halves. Retain the approximate overall proportions and the positions of hips, knees, ankles, neck joints, head and feet. Never turn the body into a cube, fat sphere or humanoid torso. No backpack, wheels or wings added.

Draw ONE coherent refined enclosure design consistently across all views. Smooth purposeful surface transitions, rounded three-dimensional cross sections, subtle precise parting lines that follow REAL component boundaries. No random color patches. No punched-out circles on the neck. No round neck tumors. The entire neck is covered in slim rounded overlapping shrouds that visually form a continuous S curve; joint breaks are narrow, intentional and regular. The head-to-neck transition is tucked under a collar without a gaping exposed connector.

Body: a continuous clean belly edge and smooth mango surfaces. Remove all sawtooth edges, stair-shaped hip cutouts, jagged gaps and miscellaneous holes. Hips emerge through tight rounded side interfaces with neatly nested circular joint collars. No giant open black rectangular side windows. One restrained regular rear service-panel boundary and one consolidated recessed ventilation grille, no scattered rear holes.

Legs: fully enclosed on the OUTBOARD, INBOARD and REAR sides. Rounded tapered form around each leg link, Tangpa-like tidy nested joint covers; neither exposed inner ladders/steel struts nor thick rectangular extruded plates. Three-dimensional softly curved forms, not a silhouette extruded into a slab. Keep the knees and ankle joints legible with a narrow, regular articulation seam rather than raw circular holes. No disembodied floating joints. The rear view MUST show genuinely complete leg coverage.

Feet: clean elongated rounded domed shoe crowns with a thin continuous dark sole, shaped like Tangpa's feet. Fully cover the ankle-to-shoe mechanism. One orderly curved ankle transition, no exposed rods, brackets, rectangular voids, stacked plates, crisscross contours, tiny protruding parts or torn-looking edges. Keep the bill and shoes goose-like rather than claws.

Presentation: white/light-gray paper, restrained grayscale only, crisp charcoal technical sketch lines and smooth neutral gray marker shading with a few controlled soft highlights. Strong legible contours and careful line weights, polished industrial design presentation. No colors at all. Landscape sheet. Large elegant front three-quarter whole robot on the left; consistent orthographic right-side and rear views in the middle/right; a generous close-up of the ankle and shoe at bottom right. All feet on a common ground plane in the views. No photoreal noisy grain, no exploded view, no transparent shells, no pseudo dimensions. No beauty effects hiding interfaces.

Only text: a small title “Goose V0.2 · 单色造型草案” and a discreet footer “造型草案，非CAD验收”. This is explicitly a visual design proposal, not the validated hardware model.

prompt_history.instruction_summary: Remove unwanted nicks and isolated holes from mango body; preserve overall shape and all views.

prompt_history.exact_prompt:
Precisely edit this SAME monochrome Goose industrial design concept sheet. Preserve its complete composition, all proportions, camera head, intact bill, mango body, fully enclosed curved legs, rear service panel, regular ventilation grilles, grayscale linework, title and "造型草案，非CAD验收" footer. Preserve the prior correction that removed the unwanted nicks/holes on the mango body; do NOT reintroduce them.

User correction: eliminate gratuitous crack-like panel lines wherever a single enclosure can form the surface. Apply consistently to the large hero, side, rear and foot close-up:
1. The entire SHOE UPPER, including toe dome, sidewall and heel enclosure, must read as ONE uninterrupted smoothly molded crown. Remove the diagonal transverse line crossing from the ankle area over the toe dome. Remove the low horizontal/curved line dividing the heel/sidewall from the toe crown. Remove any tiny extra seam below or around the lower back of the ankle cheek that only divides one continuous shoe upper. In the foot close-up these unwanted lines are around x=75%, y=78.7%; x=75.2%, y=82.2%; x=62%, y=79.6% of the whole sheet. Keep the circular ankle JOINT articulation boundary itself and the boundary between the white continuous upper and the dark rubber sole. Keep the leg entering the ankle interface physically separate rather than fusing leg and foot into one rigid stick.
2. Remove the gratuitous circumferential cuff/diagonal strip line around the BOTTOM THIRD OF THE NECK immediately above the body, around x=37.4%, y=34.7% of the whole sheet. Merge that small neck-root trim piece visually into the main lower-neck cover as a single continuous elegant surface. Keep the real neck-to-body articulation boundary where the neck enters the body, and keep the purposeful upper neck articulation seams. Do not create a new ring or collar to replace the removed line.
All these edits must be reflected in ALL views. No new details, no extra holes, no altered silhouette, no color, no new decorative strips. Give the surfaces calm continuous highlights without drawing substitute crease lines where the seams were removed.

Make ONE minimal consistency correction to this same monochrome Goose V0.2 concept sheet. Preserve all four drawings, layout, proportions, complete goose bill, mango body, side-mounted hips, fully enclosed legs, ONE-PIECE shoe uppers, grayscale linework, title, and footer. No colors.

A review found the main hero neck looks like one fused solid S, while the upper-right side view shows a mid-neck articulation. Make the same real mid-neck articulation legible consistently in the HERO and rear view, matching the side view: at the bend between the upper short neck cover and lower long S-neck cover, use ONE narrow clean recessed curved articulation boundary. Follow the actual joint cover intersection; do not add a decorative band, a thick collar, a visible motor, or a big round bump. The covered neck must retain a continuous flowing goose silhouette with smooth overlapping cover lips and an unobtrusive movement gap. The head-to-upper-neck and neck-to-body movement interfaces already shown remain.

STRICTLY PRESERVE the previous seam removals: no circumferential cuff line on the lower neck immediately above the body; no diagonal/transverse toe-dome seam; no low shoe sidewall/heel split; no extra little seam below the ankle cheek. Shoes stay complete smooth single white shells with only the circular ankle articulation and dark rubber sole boundary. No isolated body holes/nicks, no ornamental holes, no new seams elsewhere, no changed grille or rear service door. This is a local view-consistency revision, not a new design. Keep “造型草案，非CAD验收” intact.

Edit reference image 1, the latest Goose V0.2 monochrome design sheet. Reference image 2 is an earlier version and is supplied ONLY to locate the MID-NECK articulation seam. Restore precisely that small seam at the S-neck elbow from image 2 to image 1. Do not treat the seam behind the camera head as the mid-neck joint.

In the LARGE LEFT HERO (1536x1024 image), the seam crosses the narrow neck at approximately x=355 to 460, y=180 to 205, following a gentle curved diagonal from the LEFT outer convex elbow to the RIGHT inner curve. This is midway down the exposed neck, well below the horizontal rear head hood. It separates the short upper angled neck shroud from the long lower shroud. Draw it as one narrow recessed curved joint line with smooth overlapping lips, matching the earlier reference. It must not look like a crack. In the SMALL SIDE VIEW add the corresponding quiet line from approximately x=919,y=160 to x=977,y=173 at the matching S-elbow. Preserve the existing small rear-view joint line at the corresponding neck height. These must represent the SAME covered moving joint in every drawing.

Everything else MUST stay as in reference image 1: preserve seamless lower neck-root cover, smooth one-piece shoe uppers without diagonal toe cuts or low sidewall seams, round ankle articulation outline and dark sole only, clean mango body without isolated holes, same grilles and rear service panel, same body and leg proportions, camera, intact goose bill, no colors, same layout/title/footer. No new collars or circular neck bumps. No extra seams anywhere else. Explicitly retain “造型草案，非CAD验收”.
